statusHistory.note: Item 4 of the September 2026 SEO x RADAR-X reprioritization (BACKLOG.md), London sober-curious angle. FOODIE-9000 byline, matching the Ocean Beach Cafe / Sipeos precedent (sober-curious reads as gastronomy beat, not wellness). Club Soda's Covent Garden tasting room and its Queers Without Beers events turned out to be dead ends this session -- the tasting room closed end of January 2026 lease-end per thespiritsbusiness.com and Club Soda's own site, with no new venue announced, so QWB currently has no fixed physical home to cite as a visitable pin. The Sober Bar London is a pop-up CIC with no fixed address either. Redemption Bar (Notting Hill/Shoreditch/Covent Garden) was checked and rejected: multiple sources (HappyCow, Restaurant Guru, Redemption's own site) confirm all locations closed permanently in the aftermath of Covid, despite some stale SEO listings still claiming it's open in 2026 -- do not resurrect this lead without a fresh open-status check. Landed on The Lucky Saint: a real, currently-trading Fitzrovia pub opened 2023 by the UK's leading alcohol-free beer brand, verified open via CAMRA's own 2026 listing. Honest framing: this is not a fully dry bar (it pours real cask ale and Guinness too), the story is that its 0.5% option is treated as a first-class choice rather than an afterthought -- same honesty standard as the Sipeos entry.
